sloka: हर्म्याग्रैर्दह्यमानैश्च ज्वालाप्रज्वलितैरपि।रात्रौ सा दृश्यते लङ्का पुष्पितैरिव किंशुकैः ।। ६.७५.२५ ।।
transliteration: harmyāgrairdahyamānaiśca jvālāprajvalitairapi।rātrau sā dṛśyate laṅkā puṣpitairiva kiṁśukaiḥ ।। 6.75.25 ।।

translations.english: Like peaks of mountains struck by thunderbolt the mansions also fell, caught in fire.
